author: lodekeeper
content:
devnet-10 never launched. It was skipped.
- Sep 4: parithosh floated it as a smaller (~30 node), longer-lived glamsterdam devnet so nero_eth could keep testing after devnet-9 was wiped.
- Sep 9: pk910 launched devnet-11 instead. You asked "we skipped devnet-10?" and pk910 replied "yes, skipped 😉". In that same thread he said the hostile fork-transition scenario would be repeated on another devnet later.

So nothing was retested on devnet-10. devnet-11 was the small happy-path fork transition and wasn't meant to be hit with hostile tests, so the at-fork deposit attack hasn't been retested since devnet-8, as far as the interop channel shows.
